quantifier.statement: For every actual persistent Type-I/CHARGED overflow state S=(p,R,K;A,sigma) that survives the declared terminal-first dispatcher, with p a core prime p congruent to 1 modulo 24, A>1, 4K=pR+1, A|K, R>p, and Sol(4,p) as the chart-independent mark, the fixed precedence below must return exactly one of TERMINAL, FAMILY_EMPTY, or a common-admission VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR(E1-E5).
quantifier.high_support_subdomain: A>B_p=((p-1)^2)/4 and the source carries an actual sink/SCC receipt or an explicitly classified empty-improvement result.
cofactor_subdomains: C=K/A=1, including the fixed-protocol local minimum boundary
C=K/A>1, including nonempty and empty rank-improvement sets
actualness: source occurrence and raw path are replayable
terminal-first miss and branch precedence are recorded
fixture rows, arithmetic descriptors, registry names, and recursive_edge_eligible booleans do not establish actualness

required_invariants: p is a core prime in the theorem's arithmetic domain
mark is the chart-independent Sol(4,p) receipt
terminal-first has returned MISS before this track is entered
excluded_domains: A=1 source states; they belong to the dedicated A=1 dual-reset track
Type-II relation endpoints and proper-root k>1 states
formal checkpoints, pending_dispatch normalization, and transient determinant charts
p=73 as a universal theorem; p=73 is retained only as a negative/positive control
archive/ and docs/archive/ as active source or proof authority
state_domain.C_definition: C=K/A; C=1 and C>1 are separate leaves and no C=1 route may be reused for C>1 without a new proof.

fixed_precedence.meaning: Run all declared direct Type-I/Type-II/marked terminal predicates before any overflow constructor. A HIT returns TERMINAL and is not queued.
Use only an actual complete-excess/source receipt on the same canonical (p,R,K) chart with M>A, A|M, and a strict parent-to-target charged rank drop.
Try dual d/r carriers only after joining old support A'=lcm(A,t); require A'>A, A'|K_t, and strict T5 charged rank. A support-losing reset cannot bypass this leaf.
For pn=4Md+1, try deterministic bounded L|Md (and the dual fixed-s refinement) with A<L<=B_p, 4L>n or 4L>s, canonical target identity, and strict charged rank.
Run the full-block complete-excess M adapter only with an actual source receipt; target typing, owner, serializer, and re-entry must be independently admitted.
Run canonical total-cofactor projection only on a registered persistent source with a bound determinant receipt; suppress t=0 stutter and compare parent-to-target rank.
For A>B_p, use the complete sink/SCC candidate map with deterministic path and c_Q tie-break; split C=1 and C>1 empty-improvement cases before accepting any route.

Anything surviving all prior guards is an explicit residual. It may not be queued under a generic overflow label; it must be proven EMPTY, TERMINAL, or supplied a new E1-E5 target shape and admission request.

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual persistent source plus A|M and M/A>=2
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: same-chart charged rank decreases even when M>B_p
established_local_lemmas.boundary: does not supply source existence, global candidate nonemptiness, or common E3 serializer

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual source, dual t, joined support A'=lcm(A,t), A'>A, A'|K_t, strict rank
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: joined-support reset is a possible CHARGED LOCAL_DROP or marked absorb
established_local_lemmas.boundary: failed conditions remain evidence; no automatic alternate

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual source and deterministic bounded divisor L satisfying all positivity and rank inequalities
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: fixed-n target has canonical chart and identity lift with strict outer rank
established_local_lemmas.boundary: existence of L is not universal

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual dual fixed-s source and L|rd satisfying the analogous conditions
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: fixed-s target has canonical chart and identity lift with strict outer rank
established_local_lemmas.boundary: existence of L is not universal

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: externally registered persistent source, parent receipt, terminal-first miss, and determinant binding
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: source/target hit-F-G retyping, E3 adapter checks, identity lift, and conditional LOCAL_DROP
established_local_lemmas.boundary: the adapter cannot prove its own source registration or global reachability

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual high-support F/G source with a finite sink SCC receipt
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: every candidate with c_Q<K/A is a possible strict local edge; p=73 has one strict candidate
established_local_lemmas.boundary: empty candidate set is not a global no-go; p=73 is not a universal proof

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: actual high-support TYPEI/CHARGED source with C=1 and eta=0
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: same-protocol complete-excess and total-cofactor routes cannot pay E5
established_local_lemmas.boundary: does not close C=1 by terminal/outer-rank/lower-protocol, and does not reduce C>1

established_local_lemmas.usable_guard: the recorded p=409 A=5 raw-anchor candidate
established_local_lemmas.conclusion: raw H=(409,251,25665;5) is not a canonical charged parent and has no verified predecessor
established_local_lemmas.boundary: candidate remains analysis evidence until a new noncanonical bridge is proved

forbidden_inferences: p=73 sink-SCC success implies universal high-support success
recursive_edge_eligible=True implies actual source or queue admission
persistent_queue=True in a fixture implies an upstream enqueue gate
a complete-excess or divisor arithmetic identity implies E1 actual occurrence
a local checkpoint decrease or transient-to-target decrease pays parent-to-final E5
C=1 no-go can be reused to classify C>1 empty-improvement states
p=409 numeric equality can reconstruct a missing charged-history parent
registry count or family label proves source/constructor exhaustiveness
finite candidate enumeration proves EMPTY for an infinite actual domain
total-cofactor t=0 canonical stutter is a successor
archive evidence may populate active source, owner, or serializer fields
